system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Shi Hou Clan can utilize tools of war as an extension of their own spirit, infusing their Inner Chi into a weapon, manipulating its form. You can choose one weapon in your possession from the Polearm weapon group, infusing your chi into it, until it becomes Spirit Bonded to you. You can have up to two Spirit Bonded weapons at a time. You can change the weapon you are Spirit Bonded to at the conclusion of a Full-Rest. A weapon you are Spirit Bonded with gains the Reach 1 weapon property if it doesn’t have the Reach property already.

While in combat, while you have a Spirit Bonded weapon, you can do the following, each of which lasts for 1 minute;

Shi Zhou Suo. As a bonus action you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, shrinking its size, granting it the Hidden and Light weapon property and removing the Two-Handed and Heavy properties as well as reducing its bulk to 0. Reduce its damage die size by 1 step. You cannot use Fāyù while using this ability.

Zengzhang. As a bonus action, you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, increasing its length. Increase its Reach property by +1. Beginning at 7th level increase Reach gained by +2. Beginning at 15th level, increase the Reach gained by +3.

Fāyù. You can spend an Action to massively increase its weight. The Weapon gains the Heavy and Critical 2 weapon properties. You cannot use Shi Zhou Suo while using this ability.

Hui. As an Object interaction, if you are using Shi Zhou Suo or Fāyù, you dispel their effects.
